name: depot
description: Depot CI, container builds and GitHub Actions runners through Depot's official CLI (@depot/cli@0.0.1-cli.2.103.6, Depot CLI 2.103.6), run with the owner's Depot API token as DEPOT_TOKEN. Depot has no official MCP server, so the skills drive the pinned CLI from the shell: run workflows against local changes, read run status, logs and failure diagnoses, retry jobs, and list projects and builds. Includes a workflow template that mints a short-lived Entire service-account session through Depot CI OIDC.

DEPOT_TOKEN.description: Depot API token: an organization token from Depot → Settings → API tokens, or a personal token from depot login. The Depot CLI reads it from the environment.
